headline: Your phone now says when the recordings land
lede: PLAICRAFT stage 7 puts an honest pill on the screen: takes announce themselves as SAVED the moment they persist, SYNCING while the phone retries, and N TAKE(S) SYNCED on the attract screen after a relaunch — so a subway run with no signal still ends in confirmation, not guessing.

notes.text: Sync badge ships across the PLAICRAFT capture titles (Gauntlet, Short Order Shout, Talk Me Down, Rally Co-Driver): bottom-center pill, amber while pending, green when the store has it — and it never appears on devices with no store, because it would be lying.

The claim is coupled to persistence, not decoration: 7 new browser gates kill Chrome mid-upload and require the pill to show SAVED before the kill and SYNCED after the relaunch drain; strip the persist line and both go red together.
Slot b added the back panel to TALK ME DOWN — tilt a module UP and work the riveted plate; the dial reads battery counts off the back, and round 1 finally matches the manual exactly.

GitHub Actions stalled studio-wide for ~40 minutes today (dispatches accepted, none surfaced); the merge waited on static via the check-runs API and went green once the platform recovered. BOMB DEFUSE, a capture title #1711 names that doesn't exist yet, is now on the board as #1800.
